1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 10 m de altura, de copa densa y follaje persistente, con hojas y flores blancas que se usan en medicina popular contra afecciones pulmonares. Steculiaceae Sterculia foetida.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching up to 10 m in height, with a dense canopy and persistent foliage, featuring white leaves and flowers that are used in folk medicine to treat respiratory ailments. Sterculiaceae Sterculia foetida.
